content: Hi, I'm Justin McClung, a grad student at Kennesaw State. I'd like to add a proof that S and T generate SL(2, ℤ) (Subgroup.closure {S, T} = ⊤), which is currently missing from Mathlib.NumberTheory.Modular. The proof would use the Euclidean algorithm on the bottom-left entry. Would this be a good first contribution?
The link above works for me. Does it not work for you? (comment updated)

I missed that! Good to know it's already there. Is there anything related that's still missing that would be useful? I'm looking for a good first contribution in this area, ultimately working toward vector-valued modular forms.
Maybe you can search for modular form open PR and see where it is at?

Will do. I'm still a bit confused, though. That link does work, but does it mean that SL2Z_generators is in Mathlib4? I see a mention in Kevin Buzzard's Lean 3 birthday repo from 2018, but nothing in the current library.
Yes, that's a link to the latest Mathlib4 doc
If you click on source, it will take you to the corresponding Mathlib4 file.
Got it! Thank you all. I'm obviously new here and just learning, so I really appreciate the help.
